shared_elements: bearded male head with elaborately curled beard
low relief carving of processional dignitaries
stylized rows of dot/bead-like curls rendered as regular repeated units
justification: Both depict bearded male dignitaries in strict profile with tightly regimented, bead-like rows of curls in beard and hair, patterned headgear and detailed robes carved in shallow relief — a very specific and conventionalized figure type shared by both. The difference is in scale and composition: A shows a continuous frieze of many full-length figures marching in file along a stepped terrace, while B isolates a single overlapping head-and-shoulders pair on a rectangular panel.
